codeReview.summary: Well-implemented API types and client module. Types correctly match backend API responses from packages/api/src/routes.ts. Code follows project conventions (biome.json: tabs, single quotes, no semicolons). ApiError class includes status, message, and data as required. Test coverage is comprehensive with 11 tests covering happy paths, error cases, and edge cases.

sharedStateObservations.observation: frontend-worker skill requires manual verification with agent-browser (step 4), but for this API client module (types + fetch wrapper), the worker only ran automated tests. No UI component existed to verify. This is reasonable but skill could clarify when browser verification can be skipped.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill says: 'Start the dev server and verify in browser... Then use agent-browser to verify'. Worker handoff shows no interactiveChecks, only commandsRun.
